Name: (AT) Fruit Smoothie - Furniture Recolors for Alternative Textures
Author: LyssaLoryn
Description:
[b]FRUIT SMOOTHIE 2.0 IS HERE [/b]and is a complete revamp of this mod with a new palette. I will be adding more textures over time, apologies for the wait!

I hope you enjoy my "Fruit Smoothie" Furniture Recolors!

This mod adds Black, White, Red, Pink, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple and a number of pastel swatches to most of the furniture in the game via Alternative Textures. My goal was to create a fun, bright palette that makes decorating more cohesive.

[b]This mod requires [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures by PeacefulEnd

[/url][b]To Install & Use:[/b]
- Unzip .zip file
- Place contents ([AT] Fruit Smoothie Recolors) in your mods folder
- Purchase the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]Paint Bucket[/url] from Robin's Carpentry to change the color of furniture

Downloads.Description: Rainbow + pastel recolors for miscellaneous furniture.
